title: S5a: isopotential_partition@1, cytoplasmic_bridge_closure@1, scheduled_membrane_insertion@2 and restricted_cleft_lumen@2 against R-ops, R-tissue and the analytic limits
status: PROPOSED, not registered: drafted 14 November 2026 for the lead's review with the advisor. No judged run has been made. Q2's scale is pending in R-ops (Appendix A.8, the increment form's term): Q2's frozen draws were fixed before it lands.

references.interface: validation/division/REFERENCES_USAGE.md; the adapters are built from it alone

rules.tolerances: Every tolerance number is computed from a development run named beside it (validation/division/s5_protocol.py draft); development runs are not judged.
rules.judged_run: once per item, after registration, from a fresh clean execution snapshot of main (validation/source_snapshot.py, no dirty patch). Each judged driver refuses an unregistered protocol and a run outside a clean snapshot (to be added at registration). A failure is recorded and diagnosed, never retuned.

Q1.claim: Every @3 and operator ledger closes on host and device across partitions, with insertion, lumen, bridge and injection.
Q1.worlds: compact 1 -> 2 and 1 -> 2 -> 4 (tests/partition_fixtures), and the egg-scale world (validation/division/egg_division_world.py) at full scale
Q1.pass: no ledger, domain or dissipation check fails on any row, host and device
as_built: validation/division/egg_division_world.py (windowed, device checks on every row, then the host replay)
Q1.judged_run: the egg-scale world once, at 0.25 ms, with a 6G memory cap; the compact worlds through their test files at the judged snapshot

Q2.claim: The engine's event map equals R-ops'.
cases: each world's events: the compact symmetric and asymmetric worlds, the neighbour contact, the bridge world's first and second divisions, the asymmetric furrow world with a bridge, the second-onset world's first division
the simultaneous second divisions as the engine applies them (bridge world, second-onset world), against R-ops applying them one after the other, in both orders

worlds: asymmetric neighbour world: divided(neighbour=True, f=0.75, area_fraction=0.6, carriers={Na: 0.3, K: 0.5, M: 0.2})
frozen_draws.seed: numpy default_rng(20261113), fresh per world and spread
frozen_draws.rule: every draw the composite's control domain check admits, with the control at the event, is compared; no other bound applies, and no draw is redrawn

Q2.tolerance: 64 eps x R-ops' own magnitude per compared quantity (the lead's ruling). For a cell's node charge, input and daughters alike, R-ops' magnitude adds |Q| + 1e-15 F sum |z dn|, the increment form's term, carried through its own solve (Appendix A.8, pending in R-ops); clefts unchanged. A key without an R-ops magnitude compares at 64 eps x (|engine| + |R-ops|).

negative_controls.cases: the asymmetric neighbour world's bound state and its admitted spread-1 draw whose daughter sits nearest 0 V after the event; the asymmetric furrow world
negative_controls.defects: R-ops given a_k + delta for membrane_0 (potentials cannot show it: a patch's charge and capacitance split together), and the parent's node charge + delta |Q_P|; delta from 1e-16 to 1e-2 in quarter decades
negative_controls.report: the smallest delta caught (ratio above 64) on the daughters' charges, on the potentials and on any key, under the old and the new scales
negative_controls.proposed_pass: where the case's undefected ratio passes, a_k + 1e-9 is caught on the charges, and the parent's charge + 1e-9 |Q_P| on the charges and the potentials (for the lead to set)

Q2.judged_run: q2_rops_comparison once at the judged snapshot, with R-ops' amended magnitudes; every case reported under both the old and the new scale

out_of_domain_94.7.note: uncompensated increments; the states pass @3's bare domain check but fail the composite's control domain check in 197 of 200 (the gating laws' voltage domains) and the dropped 10% band in all 200. Cause: the engine forms charges in increment form, and its rounding scales with the increments' ionic content.

rounding_cause.note: |engine - R-ops| scales with the increments' ionic content at fixed net charge: median ratio 9.3-10.0 at 10x and 96-112 at 100x (asymmetric world); A.1's whole content is about 1,370 times the increments'.

Q3.claim: Trajectories after partition agree with R-tissue.
Q3.worlds: quartered furrow (cleft_quartered, passive, 1 pA into d1) and neighbour contact (asymmetric f 0.75, a 0.6, three mismatch carriers, the contact's gate fixed open, 1 pA into d1); validation/division/q3_tissue_comparison.py
Q3.records: strictly after each division instant and off the onset instants
Q3.quantities: each live cell's Vm; each lumen's volume and composition; the bridge current; each contact's current in R-tissue's direction
Q3.engine_step_term_rule: |Q(0.25 ms) - Q(0.125 ms)| per quantity and record
Q3.reference_term_rule: |R-tissue(SMALL atol) - R-tissue(SMALL x 1e-3)| per quantity and record
Q3.tolerance_rule: 3 x (step + reference) per quantity and record; where both terms fall below it, the floor 64 eps x the quantity's scale (its largest |value| over the world's records, the engine's at the judged step) serves instead
Q3.verdict_rule: pass when every |engine - R-tissue| at each record is within its tolerance

Q4.claim: The analytic limits (design §7.3) hold, each to its stated tolerance.
limits: symmetric division at the event: daughters bitwise half the parent, moved transfers and the chemical work exact zeros, the capacitor term within 1e-14 of 1/2 C (0.1 V)^2 (test_partition.py)
symmetric trajectories: every field and potential of d1 and d2 within 64 eps of its scale for 50 ms (test_division_limits_runs.py)
asymmetric division: increments to 1e-12, Q_D1 = a q to 1e-12, the unmixing work RT sum delta^2 / (2 n f (1 - f)) to 1e-3 and >= 0 (test_partition.py)
isopotential split: the daughters at the parent's potential to 1e-12 (test_partition.py)
open bridge: its conductance 2 a sigma_cyt to 1e-3, and 1 - V2/V1 = R_b / (Rm + R_b) to 1% at 0.25 ms (test_bridge_closure_runs.py)
closed bridge (a = 0): the trans-cleft T-network's coupling, cleft ratio and input resistance to 1%, and the bridge-free world's response to 1e-9 (test_division_limits_runs.py)
sealed cleft (A/L = 0): R_j = 1/G_f1 + 1/G_f2 = 2 r_new / A_face to 1%, the coupling to 1% (test_division_limits_runs.py)

Q5.claim: The observed order is about 2 after partitions.
Q5.rule: each measurable component's observed order log2(e1 / e2) lies in the band [1.8, 2.3] (proposed); components whose change is within 64 eps of the quantity's scale are rounding and counted apart
Q5.stop_condition: stop and report if any measurable component's step term fails to decrease from the (0.5, 0.25 ms) pair to the (0.25, 0.125 ms) pair (S3's)

as_built: restart at t_e - dt, t_e and t_e + dt, and from a checkpoint written after a partition, bitwise (test_partition_runs.py)

a vector-window batch mixing worlds by value equals each scalar run within 1e-12 of each field's scale, bitwise against itself reversed; a batch mixing static structures is refused (test_partition_runs.py, test_cleft_division_runs.py)
E_ref, q_ref and partition_birth_gate are bindings, never compiled in (validation/division/division_crossrev.py check)

items: an idle partition and an idle bridge are bitwise the composition without them (test_partition.py, test_partition_runs.py, test_bridge_closure.py): built
the 19-cell sheet at the 64-node cap with idle division operators, bitwise: not built

S3's cleft egg on insertion@2 and lumen@2 under a registered operator variant of S3's protocol (S3's tolerances unchanged; its judge gains the variant's acceptance); the comparison with S3's judged run reported: not built
crossrev: every existing set identical, S5's own set recorded (crossrev-s5a11, crossrev-s5a10-division): built

Q9.claim: Closed slots are @3 padding at the view; the lumen's padded-slot test.

Q10.claim: Sensitivity to the partition time and to a_0 (design §4.2).
Q10.tolerance_rule: per world and quantity, 3 x the nominal run's step term |Q(0.25 ms) - Q(0.125 ms)|, with Q3's floor (64 eps x the quantity's largest |value|) where the step term falls below it (proposed); a change within it is insensitive, otherwise t_p and a_0 enter that quantity's band
Q10.note: the nominal bridge exchange is exactly 0 (the bridge closes at 3 ms, before the current starts), so its tolerance is 0 and any exchange a variant opens is a change; without injection every arm's change is exactly 0

Q11.claim: The retirement record is state wherever state goes.
as_built: history rows, checkpoints, host replays and the summary carry the record; the negative control (record zeroed) fails the local and outside ledgers (test_partition_runs.py)
at egg scale: the windowed run's rows replay with identical diagnostics; the negative control fails (egg_division_world.py)
